name: Data Analyst
tagline: Turns raw data into actionable insights — analysis, reports, and charts delivered via SharePoint.
description:
The Data Analyst handles your team's data work end-to-end. Give it a task via email — analyze a dataset, build a report, parse documents, consolidate information from teammates — and it delivers results to SharePoint with Excel reports, charts, and written summaries.

It runs Python (pandas, matplotlib, numpy) for real analysis, reads and writes Excel on SharePoint, parses PDFs and Word docs, and collaborates with your team over email to gather missing information. Every outbound email to people outside your company goes through your approval queue first.

Set it up once with your team structure and data sources during onboarding. It handles the rest — you review the work.

capabilities.name: Data analysis
capabilities.description: Runs Python (pandas, matplotlib, numpy, seaborn) for statistical analysis and visualization

capabilities.name: Report generation
capabilities.description: Creates Excel reports and charts, uploads to SharePoint for team access

capabilities.name: Document parsing
capabilities.description: Extracts data from PDFs, Word docs, and Excel files

capabilities.name: Team collaboration
capabilities.description: Emails teammates for missing data, updates manager on progress, coordinates across people

capabilities.name: Research and consolidation
capabilities.description: Gathers information from multiple sources and consolidates into structured deliverables

capabilities.name: Knowledge sharing
capabilities.description: Contributes reusable analysis patterns to AgentMind for other Data Analyst instances
